name: mapper-frontend
//svg2pdf.js: svg2pdf.js is pinned to EXACTLY 2.7.0 — no caret — and must not be bumped without re-testing chart PDF export. 2.8.1's UMD build cannot resolve jsPDF at import time: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'jsPDF')` at svg2pdf.js/src/utils/fonts.ts:62, thrown while loading src/components/charts/chartExport.ts — so the module fails to load and chart PDF export breaks outright, rather than degrading. This is NOT a version-range problem: 2.7.0 and 2.8.1 declare the SAME peer range (jspdf ^4.0.0 || ^3.0.0 || ^2.0.0) and ours is 4.2.1, which satisfies it. It is an upstream interop regression. Dependabot PR #86 was closed over this; see PR #111 which landed its other seven bumps.
